001package pkg_RoomPack;
002
003public class Door
004{
005    private boolean aIsLocked;
006    private boolean aOneWay;
007    
008    /**
009     * Constructeur d'objets de classe Door
010     */
011    public Door()
012    {
013        this.aIsLocked = true;
014        this.aOneWay   = false;
015    }
016    
017    public void lockDoor()
018    {
019        if ( !this.aIsLocked ) this.aIsLocked = true;
020    }
021    
022    public void unlockDoor()
023    {
024        if ( this.aIsLocked ) this.aIsLocked = false;
025    }
026    
027    public boolean isLocked()
028    {
029        return this.aIsLocked;
030    }
031    
032    public void oneWay()
033    {
034        this.aOneWay = true;
035    }
036    
037    public boolean isOneWay()
038    {
039        return this.aOneWay;
040    }
041}
